name: Proximity Lock
author: hex0x90
description: Keeps your Omarchy computer awake while your phone is nearby and locks immediately when you walk away.

barWidget.description: Automatic lock and stay-awake management based on your phone's Bluetooth proximity.

schema.label: Phone Bluetooth MAC Address
schema.description: MAC address of your paired phone (e.g. AA:BB:CC:DD:EE:FF).

schema.label: Phone Name
schema.description: Display name of the paired phone.

schema.label: RSSI Signal Threshold (dBm)
schema.description: Signal strength threshold. Closer is higher (e.g. -70 = close, -85 = farther).

schema.label: Poll Interval (seconds)
schema.description: How often to check phone proximity. Each check runs a short Bluetooth scan; lower values keep the radio busier and slow down other Bluetooth devices reconnecting. Minimum 8.

schema.label: Consecutive Missed Checks Before Lock
schema.description: Prevents accidental locks if the phone briefly drops signal in a pocket.

schema.label: Immediate Lock When Away
schema.description: Instantly lock screen when you walk away, instead of waiting for standard idle timer.

schema.label: Show Desktop Notifications
schema.description: Notify when computer unlocks/stays awake or locks due to proximity.
